value.answer: For the US market, I'd go with the Honda Odyssey. U.S. News has it #1 at 9.3 out of 10, Car Talk's staff picked it, and Edmunds says it's the minivan it most likes driving. It's not unanimous, though. Edmunds ranks the Toyota Sienna #1, mainly for its standard hybrid and 36 mpg, so if fuel economy matters most, that's the one to look at.
